query:
SELECT 
  'molecules' as table_name, COUNT(*) as count FROM molecules
UNION ALL SELECT 'recettes', COUNT(*) FROM recettes
UNION ALL SELECT 'accords', COUNT(*) FROM accords
UNION ALL SELECT 'tabacs', COUNT(*) FROM tabacs
UNION ALL SELECT 'prototypes', COUNT(*) FROM prototypes
UNION ALL SELECT 'families', COUNT(*) FROM families
UNION ALL SELECT 'glossary', COUNT(*) FROM glossary
UNION ALL SELECT 'plants', COUNT(*) FROM plants
UNION ALL SELECT 'terp_profiles', COUNT(*) FROM terp_profiles
UNION ALL SELECT 'final_recipes', COUNT(*) FROM final_recipes
UNION ALL SELECT 'leaf_economies', COUNT(*) FROM leaf_economies
UNION ALL SELECT 'terpene_synergies', COUNT(*) FROM terpene_synergies
UNION ALL SELECT 'citations', COUNT(*) FROM citations
UNION ALL SELECT 'ifra_restrictions', COUNT(*) FROM ifra_restrictions
UNION ALL SELECT 'geographic_origins', COUNT(*) FROM geographic_origins
ORDER BY count DESC;
